LAYOUT IS THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT. Draw 8 poses in ONE STRAIGHT HORIZONTAL ROW. Every pose sits at the SAME vertical height, evenly spaced left to right, with a WIDE EMPTY BLACK GAP between each one. DO NOT arrange the poses along a curve or an arc. DO NOT stagger them vertically. DO NOT let any pose touch or overlap its neighbours. This is a sprite sheet grid, not an illustration of a jump path.

SUBJECT: an 8-frame JUMP AND FALL animation for a 2D game character, side profile facing RIGHT.

THE CHARACTER — this exact outfit must be COMPLETE and IDENTICAL in ALL EIGHT poses, with no piece missing from any frame: a lean athletic cyberpunk death god. A full-face bright red #E01F26 hannya oni mask covering the WHOLE head with narrow white glowing eye slits and a fanged white grin, two red horns swept BACKWARD. A very long ponytail banded deep indigo #1E33D9 through electric blue #2B6FE8 to bright cyan #35C6F4 at the tip. A BROAD PURE WHITE SLEEVELESS CAPTAIN'S HAORI with a torn ragged hem — THE WHITE HAORI MUST BE PRESENT AND CLEARLY VISIBLE IN EVERY SINGLE FRAME, never omitted. A black tracksuit jacket with acid-green #C6F02A and cyan racing stripes. CRITICAL ARM DETAIL — the jacket SLEEVES ARE ROLLED UP AND PUSHED TO THE ELBOWS in every frame. From the elbow down, his BARE FOREARMS AND HANDS are exposed and are DEEP BROWN SKIN (#855434 base, #4A2A1A shadow, #B07A4A highlight). He is a Black man. His forearms and hands must be BROWN SKIN, never dark fabric, never grey, never pale, never gloved. The sleeve ends in a visible cuff at the elbow with brown skin below it. Black hakama trousers gathered at the ankles, black tabi boots. Katana and wakizashi both SHEATHED at his LEFT hip — no drawn weapon, no slash arcs.

THE EIGHT POSES, left to right:
1. Crouched, knees deeply bent, coiling to launch, haori pooling around him.
2. Launching, body stretched tall and upward, arms down, hair whipped straight DOWN behind.
3. Rising, knees tucking up, haori flaring open, hair still streaming down.
4. Nearing apex, body compact, knees high, hair beginning to catch up.
5. At apex, weightless, body balanced, haori spread wide, hair floating.
6. Beginning to fall, legs starting to trail below and behind, hair beginning to stream UPWARD.
7. Falling fast, legs trailing far behind, haori billowing UP hard, hair streaming straight up.
8. Landing, knees deeply bent absorbing impact, haori collapsing down around him, hair dropping.

All eight poses at the SAME SIZE and SAME SCALE, in one straight horizontal line.

PIXEL ART: chunky visible square pixels, hard aliased edges, a 1-pixel dark outline on every shape, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur.

BACKGROUND: PURE BLACK #000000. NO grid lines, NO borders, NO ground lines, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers, NO dividing rules.

STRICT PALETTE — ONLY: #000000 #0A0E1F #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #8FE8FF #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568 #4A2A1A #855434 #B07A4A.
